sloka: स त्वां मनुजशार्दूलः क्षिप्रं प्राप्स्यति राघवः ।समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं जनकात्मजे ।। ५.३५.४८।।।।
transliteration: sa tvāṁ manujaśārdūlaḥ kṣipraṁ prāpsyati rāghavaḥ ।samitrabāndhavaṁ hatvā rāvaṇaṁ janakātmaje ।। 5.35.48।।।।

translations.english: "Oh daughter of Janaka after killing Ravana, along with his friends and relatives Rama, the tiger among men, will meet you.
